latest.notes: Fixes the on-air freeze on network disruptions. Root cause: the stream reconnect watchdog and the per-track metadata pushes read the keychain synchronously on the main thread, and on macOS a keychain ACL prompt makes that call block indefinitely — freezing the whole app (and dead-airing the stream, which is why Live365 played fallback ads). Now both the stream encoder and the now-playing publisher cache their passwords in memory (loaded once, off the main thread), so a network blip or track change never touches the keychain on the main thread. On-air engine unchanged from v0.5.15.
